question: Pila ka sets sa building plan ug unsa nga mga papeles ang kinahanglan para sa Locational Clearance sa 2-storey nga balay?
answer:
Sa 2-storey nga balay, hinihingi nga 7 ka sets sa building plan para sa Locational Clearance. Ang mga papeles na kinahanglan nga ipasok sa mga set sa building plan sa [S3] City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf, chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0011-C003. Ang mga papeles na kinahanglan nga ipasok sa mga set sa building plan sa inyo ay:

1. Filled-up title blocks (1 set)
2. Signed and sealed by CE / Architect (1 set)
3. Certified True Copy of Title issued by the Registry of Deeds (ROD) o show original copy of title for validation (1 original for validation, 1 photocopy) (1 set)
4. Locational Clearance Application duly notarized and signed by the applicant (1 photocopy) (1 set)

ground_truth: Locational Clearance for 2-storey and below structures requires 7 complete sets of building plans signed/sealed by a civil engineer/architect, certified title, notarized application, vicinity sketch, bill of materials, and building permit form. Total time is 4 days, 2 hours.
